description: Vehicle listings from AutoTrader.ca (Canada; the US and UK AutoTrader sites block datacenter traffic): up to 20 per page with title, year, make, model, trim, price in CAD, AutoTrader's price label, mileage in km, transmission, fuel, new/used, dealer, city, province and URL, plus the total matching count and min/median/max price of the page. Filter by make, model, province and city. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

make.description: Make as in AutoTrader.ca URLs, e.g. ford, honda, toyota (optional)

model.description: Model as in AutoTrader.ca URLs, e.g. f-150, civic (needs make)

province.description: Province code: ab, bc, mb, nb, nl, ns, nt, nu, on, pe, qc, sk, yt (optional)
